title: Employ staff under the Social, Community, Home Care and Disability Services Industry Award 2010
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Social, Community, Home Care and Disability Services Industry Award 2010.

laws.title: Social, Community, Home Care and Disability Services Industry Award 2010

sources.title: Social, Community, Home Care and Disability Services Industry Award 2010
sources.quote: 4.1 This industry award covers employers throughout Australia in the: (a) crisis assistance and supported housing sector; (b) social and community services sector; (c) home care sector; (d) family day care scheme sector; [4.1(e) deleted by PR995399 ppc 26Mar10] and their employees in the classifications listed in Schedule B to Schedule F to the exclusion of any other modern award.

reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

reach.note: Unincorporated employers outside WA (in WA they are in the state system).

sources.title: Which system of employment laws applies
sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia (Private Sector Labour Relations)
sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

assessment.summary: The Social, Community, Home Care and Disability Services Industry Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
